text:
pagerduty: PagerDuty: page fired (P1) - auth-service: token validation failures (JWT signature mismatch) - INC-1780005

incident-bot: automated alert: spike in 401 responses from /v1/generate and /v1/chat endpoints. rate: ~5% of requests since 1780005400. Customers: hosted-api + some dedicated pools.

amanda: acked. I'm oncall. seeing the same in logs. dashboards show 401s up from 0.2% to 5.1 in the last 4m. rolling deploy completed at 1780005200, maybe related.

raj: noted. tagging infra and runtime. any recent key rotations?

miguel: I pushed the auth-service deploy earlier that included signing-key rotation logic. I validated locally but didn't test full JWKS rotation end-to-end. sorry.

sasha: ok, prioritize mitigation. Is the JWKS endpoint returning both old and new keys? can someone curl it?

opsbot: synthetic check: GET https://auth.internal.redwood/jwks returned 200 but kid list contains only the new key (kid: rk-2026-03-14). older tokens still signed by rk-2026-02-28.

amanda: that explains mismatch. clients still have tokens signed by old key. we need either to add old key to JWKS or make auth-service accept old key temporarily. which is fastest?

miguel: fastest is to update JWKS to include old key (I have the old public key). pushing config now. will take ~2-3m to propagate to edge caches.

raj: +1. while that's rolling, add a short-lived fallback for auth-service token validator to accept legacy kid until rotation completes. security ok with that?

sasha: security consulted via DM. fallback is acceptable for up to 30m during rollouts. ensure we log and alert if fallback used.

amanda: doing customer impact triage: Emily, any enterprise customers reporting 401s?

emily-csm: getting Slack threads from two customers (AcornAnalytics, FinLedger) complaining about 401s and failed inference calls. letting them know we're on it and will update in 10m.

incident-bot: mitigation plan: 1) add old key to JWKS (miguel) 2) enable validator fallback (raj) 3) monitor error rates and token issuance 4) notify customers 5) postmortem owner assigned.

miguel: pushed jwks update at 1780005530. cache-control header set low (60s). verify with curl:```
curl -s https://auth.internal.redwood/jwks | jq '.keys[].kid' 
# output: ["rk-2026-03-14", "rk-2026-02-28"]
```

amanda: confirming: edge caches show new jwks at 1780005590. auth-service logs show validator accepted old kid after fallback enabled. error rate dropping.

raj: enabled validator fallback in config and rolled at 1780005605. config snippet:```yaml
auth_validator:
  accept_additional_kids: ["rk-2026-02-28"]
  fallback_window_seconds: 1800
  log_fallback_usage: true
```

amanda: monitoring: 401 rate down to 0.6% at 1780005750. request latency stable. no 5xx spikes.

emily-csm: updated customers: AcornAnalytics and FinLedger notified. both reported partial impact and are ok with the timeline. one Dedicated customer on private JWKS had to restart their connector, working with SE.

sasha: good. next steps: keep fallback enabled for 15m, then rotate tokens and revoke old key. Miguel, can you schedule token re-issuance job?

miguel: will run a short token refresh job for internal services at 1780006000 and coordinate with partners for external tokens.

opsbot: pd-bot: INC-1780005 acknowledged by amanda at 1780005450, escalated to SRE at 1780005480.

amanda: handing off to sasha for next oncall check-in at 1780006100. leaving notes: jwks updated, fallback enabled, token refresh scheduled, CSMs notified.

sasha: taking over. will keep monitoring until metric steady <0.2% for 30m. assigning postmortem owner: sasha (auth+jwks), timeline owner: miguel, customer comms: emily-csm.

emily-csm: I'll send a summary to affected customers with ETA for full resolution (revocation + rotation complete) and follow-up once tokens reissued.

raj: security note: will audit the rotation pipeline to add an automated end-to-end check that verifies JWKS changes include both old and new keys or that clients receive new tokens prior to old key removal.

sasha: agreed. action items: [1] postmortem (sasha), [2] add e2e rotation test (raj), [3] improve deploy gating for key rotations (miguel), [4] customer follow-up (emily-csm). ETA for full closure: 1780009000 (approx 1 hr).

amanda: closing page for now, monitoring continues. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: incident status: mitigated -> monitoring.

sasha: note for postmortem: include timeline, root cause: missing old key in JWKS after rotation; human error in rotation checklist; recommend automated key propagation and pre-warm caches.

miguel: logging snippet captured during peak:```
ERROR auth.validator - token rejected - reason=signature_mismatch kid=rk-2026-02-28 token_id=abc123 client=hosted-api-1
```

amanda: final metrics at last check (1780006190): 401 rate 0.12%, errors back to baseline. marking incident as resolved after 30m stable.

sasha: will file postmortem and link here when ready. thanks team. :raised_hands:
